notes.title: 🎮 Pirates: Rogue’s Fortune sails proudly on the Steam Deck!
notes.content: [p][b]🏴‍☠️ Ahoy, crew![/b][/p][p]We’ve got some fantastic news: [b]Pirates: Rogue’s Fortune runs like a charm on the Steam Deck[/b]! The adventure takes on a whole new dimension on this portable console – smooth, immersive, and perfect for sailing anywhere you go.[/p][p][/p][p]⚓ [b]We’re actively working on a native Linux version[/b] to deliver the best possible experience to all captains out there. Stay tuned – the horizon looks promising![/p][p][/p][p]Currently, the game runs on its Windows build. If you have other Windows games to install on your Steam Deck, you just need to enable [b]Proton Experimental[/b] in your Steam ⚙️ settings:[/p][olist][*][p]Open [b]Settings ⚙️[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Go to [b]Compatibility[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Check [b]Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Select [b]Proton Experimental[/b].[/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Pirates: Rogue’s Fortune[/b] will be available in [b]Early Access[/b] in early 2026, and we can’t wait to sail with you to refine every detail thanks to your feedback.[/p][p]At Ninpô, we’re a small independent team chasing a big dream, and your support means the world to us! [b]Add the game to your wishlist and share it with your friends...[/b] It only takes a few seconds, but it helps us more than you can imagine. Thank you in advance![/p][p][/p][p]💛 [b]Add it to your wishlist now:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2423280/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]— The crew at [b]NINPÔ Game Studio[/b][/p]

notes.title: 🏴‍☠️ Discover Pirates: Rogue's Fortune!
notes.content:

[b]Discover an action and adventure rogue-lite[/b] where every attempt brings you closer to becoming a legend: [/p][list][*][p][b]Explore the ocean depths[/b] in search of treasures ⚓ [/p][/*][*][p][b]Face waves of fearsome enemies[/b] as you resurface ⚔[/p][/*][*][p][b]Upgrade your ship and arsenal[/b] to become the ultimate pirate ⛵[/p][/*][/list][p]

[/p][p]💛 [b]Add the game to your wishlist now:[/b] [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2423280/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We’ll regularly share development updates, exclusive previews, and we’re eager to hear your thoughts.
